features.title: Tactical leader
features.text: Commanders train a squad in battle tactics. Their banner helps nearby allies resist fear.

features.title: Tactics
features.text: Spend actions to give squadmates extra moves, attacks or defenses, often outside their own turns. Once a round, one ally can gain an extra reaction to follow a tactic.

review.notes: Editorial assessment of the class framework and ordinary builds. Rules references support mechanics; scores remain judgments.

ratings.offense: 2.5 → 2–3. Personal weapon damage is modest; allied attacks granted by tactics are credited to support.
ratings.defense: 3.5 → 4. Heavy armor access provides a sturdy baseline without the strongest defensive class progression.
ratings.support: 5 → 5. Tactics grant allies attacks, movement and defensive opportunities; coordination is the central strength.
ratings.utility: 3.5 → 3.5. Intelligence, skills and knowledge support useful exploration and planning.
ratings.difficulty: 4 → 4. Tactics require knowledge of squad abilities, positioning and reaction availability.
